_about: Weapons the player holds. Same rules as the other manifests (see test.json); a weapon is also a normal model, so it can lie in a level as a pickup.
A weapon's moving pieces (slide, magazine, trigger, hammer) are separate parts of its GLB, made with asset.part() in its script; web/js/weapons/ animates them.
Colours for weapons are in art/style/chapters/weapons.json.

assets.notes: 半自動手槍（自己設計，不仿任何真實型號）；可動零件：slide、magazine、trigger、hammer
